title: Block Out Level 28 Walkthrough
summary: Block Out Level 28 is a stacked chamber puzzle with a top `6` boss and a lower `2` boss. Open the lower room first, collapse the `2` panel next, and let the upper `6` fall only after the chamber is already turning.

variants.gameVersion: current iOS and Android catalog checked 2026-08-03

landmarks: Block Out Level 28 is a stacked chamber puzzle with a top `6` boss and a lower `2` boss.
Open the lower room first, collapse the `2` panel next, and let the upper `6` fall only after the chamber is already turning.
The board mixes Blue, Pink, Red and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: Solve the lower `2` before the upper `6`.
The lower chamber is the phase-one workspace.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Rotate the lower chamber first and start peeling blue and pink away through the side lanes.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Use that new space to begin shrinking the framed `2` boss.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Keep the upper `6` panel parked while the lower chamber is still crowded.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Once the `2` frame is nearly gone, let the top `6` finally start to fall.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Use the late red and yellow pieces to stop the lower chamber from refilling.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Finish the side exits after the upper boss is already low.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: End with the last bottom colors once both bosses are gone.

failurePoints: Trying to lower the `6` panel before the `2` boss has opened.
Leaving the lower chamber crowded after the first exits are available.
